item.description:
macOS 26 and later · Build 12

This collects the 0.4.0 betas and release candidates for anyone updating from 0.3.0.

New

Actions

  • Choose what Return does on a result, and which rows the Actions menu (⌘K) shows, in what order and on which keys, in Settings › Actions (#40). By @MintCollector in #68 and #105.
  • An app's hotkey runs its Primary Action, set in Settings › Actions (#40). By @MintCollector in #81.
  • Scripts can act on a result: add # @floe.subjects file, folder or # @floe.subjects text and the script shows in that result's Actions menu (INTERFACES.md).

Quicklinks

  • Import your Raycast quicklinks from Settings › Quicklinks or the welcome window (#74).
  • Quicklinks can use {selection} and {clipboard} as in Raycast, and the selection needs Accessibility access (#43).
  • A quicklink can open in an app of its own, chosen under Open with.

Windows

  • Tile the window in front from the search with Tile Window Left, Right, Top and Bottom, Maximize Window and Center Window (needs Accessibility access). By @unsecretised in #67.
  • Raycast extensions such as Window Layouts can move your windows once Floe has Accessibility access.

Checkpoints and Settings

  • A checkpoint can clear your desk: type pause and a name, press ⌘K, and choose Save and Hide Apps or Save and Quit Apps.
  • Choose a theme for Settings in Settings › General: Match System, Light, Dark, or Black for OLED displays.
  • Hide Floe's icon in the menu bar with Show in Menu Bar in Settings › General (#71). By @unsecretised in #72.

Changed

  • Extensions get only the shell variables tools need, such as PATH and HOME, so turn on "Pass on everything your shell exports" on an extension's page in Settings if it read a token from your .zshrc.
  • ⌘K opens the Actions menu inside the launcher, with a search field and the keys that run each row. By @MintCollector in #64 and #82.
  • define lists matching words and shows the whole entry in Floe; the Dictionary app moved to ⌘K, and Settings › Commands can rename define (#57).
  • Extensions show more of their interface, such as light and dark colors, section subtitles, icons on confirmations and shortcuts in menu bar commands.
  • Extensions build long lists in about half the time.
  • An extension's command with no subtitle shows the extension's name at the right of its row, so two commands with the same name can be told apart.
  • Floe does less work and holds less memory: fast typing runs fewer searches, and calendar and emoji data load the first time you need them.
  • Floe leaves the keyboard and clipboard alone when you have no snippets and clipboard history is off.
  • Updates download only what changed when they can, a few megabytes instead of about 80.
  • Paths and links use a monospaced font.
  • Lists fade out at the bottom edge instead of cutting the last row off.
  • A command's status messages crossfade with its title in the bottom bar.
  • Clipboard history has an Open Settings button when it's off.
  • A command whose view Floe can't show yet says how to tell us, with Report a Bug in Settings › About.
  • Tabs and pickers in Settings use the system's tabs control on macOS 27 and a glass selection on macOS 26.

Fixed

Launcher

  • What's New opens at the version you have, not the newest release.
  • The search shows your changes as soon as you close Settings, including an extension you just installed.
  • Apps in a folder you deleted and recreated show up without restarting Floe.
  • A command opened by its hotkey or a link while another search is open gets your typing, so Return runs the command instead of pasting.
  • ⌘Return, ⌥Return and ⇧Return work on a shell command in the search. By @MintCollector in #63.
  • A larger system text size reaches more of Floe, so file names, AI answer headings and list rows stop staying small or getting cut off.
  • The Actions menu opens at once.
  • Ask AI and the search bar show one steady spinner while they wait.
  • The file preview no longer wraps its key hints.
  • The calculator groups large numbers the way your region writes them and puts no comma after a minus sign.
  • Floe frees memory after you close it, even when a command or dialog was still open.
  • Floe keeps running when the disk fills up while diagnostic logging is on, and stops logging.

Commands

  • Commands that run without opening anything finish and say when they fail.
  • Background commands keep running after they close the launcher, as in Raycast.
  • A command still running after you go back to the search can't close the launcher or paste into the app in front.
  • Signing in to an extension in the browser keeps working when another of its commands refreshes or ends.
  • 1Password's My Passwords and My Vaults bring the launcher back after you approve sign-in, and the 1Password CLI gets its settings from your shell (#91).
  • Changing an extension's settings keeps the rest of them.
  • Restart, Shut Down, Log Out, Empty Trash, Toggle Appearance and Toggle Bluetooth say when they fail.
  • Reading text or a QR code from the screen keeps going past two minutes, and a script that runs too long says so.
  • Reminders finds your lists after you allow Floe in System Settings, without restarting Floe.

Snippets

  • Snippet keywords stay put after a click or an app switch, and Backspace corrects a keyword as you type it.
  • Expanding a snippet leaves your clipboard as it was and stays out of clipboard history.

Settings and sync

  • Buttons and tabs in Settings line up, and switching tabs no longer leaks memory.
  • The quicklink editor says why it won't save.
  • Empty lists in Settings say they're empty.
  • The Settings search finds more, under the names the pages use.
  • Clearing an extension's setting on one Mac clears it on your other Macs.
  • iCloud sync stops resending a change that keeps conflicting and reads iCloud's copy instead.

Privacy

  • Clipboard history and extensions' saved data are encrypted with a key in your keychain and stay out of Time Machine.
  • Extension passwords stay hidden from other apps while a command runs.

Security

These come from a code review of Floe on 2026-11-15.

  • Each extension's saved data has a key of its own, so one extension can't read another's or your clipboard history.
  • Clipboard images an extension read are deleted when Floe quits.
  • Importing a settings file can't switch on features you turned off, such as clipboard history, extensions, shell commands or the diagnostic log.
  • A password saved before Floe was renamed survives when the keychain refuses its new copy.
  • An AI model name can't add options to the AI tool's command, so a settings file can't send your questions to a server it names.
  • Extension text fields that look like a token, key, secret or password stay on this Mac and leave iCloud at the next sync, once each of your Macs runs 0.4.0.

Contributors

  • @MintCollector added choosing what Return does and the order of the Actions menu, made app hotkeys run the Primary Action, brought the Actions menu into the launcher with its keys, and fixed Return on shell commands (#40, #63, #64, #68, #81, #82, #105).
  • @unsecretised added the window tiling commands and hiding the menu bar icon (#67, #72).
  • @KingMob asked for the Raycast quicklinks import (#74).
  • @nuTTeLLo asked for acting on the selected text (#43).
  • @christian90875-bit reported that the 1Password CLI didn't work in Floe (#91).
  • @raumzeit77 asked for window management (#52).
  • @Evolinox asked for hiding the menu bar icon (#71).
  • @dotvhs asked for a better dictionary (#57).

macOS 26 and later · Build 11

New

  • Import your Raycast quicklinks from Settings › Quicklinks or the welcome window. Floe reads a Quicklinks export or a full Raycast backup, gives each link a keyword, and lists any it couldn't bring over (#74).
  • Quicklinks can use {selection} and {clipboard}, as in Raycast. The selection needs Accessibility access (#43).
  • A quicklink can open in an app of its own, such as a second browser for work links. Choose it under Open with.

Changed

  • Extensions no longer get your whole shell environment, only what tools need, such as PATH and HOME. If an extension relied on a token from your .zshrc, turn on "Pass on everything your shell exports" on its page in Settings.
  • An app's hotkey runs its Primary Action, set in Settings › Actions (#40).
  • ⌘K opens the Actions menu inside the launcher, with a search field, as it does in extensions.
  • Actions has its own page in Settings.
  • Extensions show more of their interface: light and dark colors, section subtitles in lists, icons on confirmations, sections in form dropdowns, and shortcuts in menu bar commands.
  • Updating from any of the last three releases downloads only what changed, a few megabytes instead of about 80.

Fixed

  • What's New opens at the version you have, not the newest release.
  • Buttons and tabs in Settings line up, and switching tabs no longer leaks memory.
  • Clipboard history and what extensions keep in their storage are encrypted, with a key kept in your keychain, so another app can't read what you copied or a token an extension saved. What was there before is encrypted the next time Floe or the extension opens it.
  • Extension passwords can't be read by other apps while a command runs. Floe used to hand them to the extension in a way any program running as you could see.
  • 1Password's My Passwords and My Vaults bring the launcher back after you approve sign-in instead of leaving it closed, and the 1Password CLI's settings from your shell, such as OP_BIOMETRIC_UNLOCK_ENABLED, now reach it (#91).
  • Snippet keywords no longer expand after a click or an app switch, so finishing a keyword in another field doesn't delete text there.
  • Expanding a snippet leaves your clipboard as it was, and the snippet no longer shows up in clipboard history.
  • Backspace corrects a snippet keyword as you type it, so a keyword fixed mid-word still expands.
  • Clipboard history and the commands you run stay out of Time Machine, and only your account can read them. Extensions' data folders are private to your account too.
  • Commands that run without opening anything now finish instead of stopping when the launcher goes back to its main search, and they say when they fail.
  • Background commands keep running after they close the launcher, as they do in Raycast.
  • A command still running after you go back to the search can't close the launcher or paste into the app in front. What it copies stays on the clipboard for you to paste.
  • Signing in to an extension in the browser no longer fails when another of its commands refreshes or ends.
  • A command opened by its hotkey or a link while clipboard history or another search is open now gets your typing, so Return runs the command's action instead of pasting the clipboard item behind it.
  • The search shows your changes as soon as you close Settings, including an extension you installed just before.
  • Apps in a folder you deleted and recreated show up without restarting Floe.
  • Changing an extension's settings no longer erases the rest when Floe can't read the settings file or a save is cut short.
  • Clearing an extension's setting on one Mac clears it on your other Macs, instead of the old value staying there.
  • iCloud sync stops resending a change that keeps conflicting and reads iCloud's copy instead.
  • Toggle Bluetooth says when macOS didn't let it change instead of claiming it is on or off.
  • Restart, Shut Down, Log Out, Empty Trash and Toggle Appearance show a message when they fail instead of doing nothing.
  • Reading text or a QR code from the screen no longer stops after two minutes, and a shell command or script that runs past its time limit says it took too long.
  • Floe no longer quits when the disk is full while diagnostic logging is on; logging stops instead.
  • Reminders finds your lists after you allow Floe in System Settings, without restarting Floe.

Security

These come from a code review of Floe on 2026-11-15.

  • Each extension's saved data is encrypted with a key of its own, so one extension can't read what another saved or your clipboard history.
  • Clipboard images an extension read are deleted when Floe quits.
  • Importing a settings file can't switch on clipboard history, extensions or commands you turned off, menu bar commands, receipts, search history, the diagnostic log, extension settings sync or shell commands without the prefix, even when the file's shell settings are damaged.
  • A password saved before Floe was renamed is no longer lost when the keychain refuses its new copy.
  • An AI model name, typed or imported, can't add options to the AI tool's command, so a settings file can't send your questions to a server it names.
  • Extension text fields that look like a token, key, secret or password stay on this Mac and are taken out of iCloud the next time Floe syncs. Update Floe on each of your Macs, since an older version still sends them.

Contributors

  • @KingMob asked for the Raycast quicklinks import (#74).
  • @nuTTeLLo asked for acting on the selected text (#43).
  • @christian90875-bit reported that the 1Password CLI didn't work in Floe (#91).
  • @MintCollector made app hotkeys run the Primary Action and brought the Actions menu into the launcher (#81, #82).

macOS 26 and later · Build 5

Note

Contributing is easier now

AGENTS.md tells AI coding agents, and the people using them, how to contribute to Floe. CODING_STANDARDS.md says how code and text are written here. Read both before you open a pull request, whether you write the change yourself or with an agent.

If an AI helps with your change, see the AI-assisted contributions section of our contribution guidelines first: you stay responsible for the change and must be able to explain it, and the tool's terms have to let you contribute its output.

Floe's Settings now share their controls and pages with Thaw through ThawUI, so the two apps look and behave more alike.

New

  • File search finds what's in iCloud Drive, and shows it under that name. With Fast file search on, macOS may ask once for access to iCloud Drive (#59).

Changed

  • A slider sets the search field's corners, from square to fully round, in place of the three shapes. The shape you had stays as it was, and an older Floe syncing from another Mac keeps working.
  • More text follows your Mac's text size, in the calculator, files, clipboard, Ask AI, Markdown and extension views. Some corners in these views and the note editor's toolbar icons change by a point or two to match the rest of the app.
  • The toolbar names each Settings page, in place of the large title at the top, as in Thaw. Each group of search results has a heading like the sidebar's.
  • About sits in the middle of its page, and its menu leaves out any link a build doesn't have.
  • A keyboard shortcut macOS already uses keeps the recording going, so you can type another one straight away.
  • The sidebar scrolls to the current page when Settings opens, and with Differentiate Without Color on, the selected row gets a ring.
  • Numbered steps in the release notes keep their numbers.

Fixed

  • What's New shows the latest releases. It was reading an older copy of the changelog that stopped at 0.1.0.
  • A link in the release notes opens only if it is https, and a page that isn't the changelog, such as a Wi-Fi sign-in page, no longer replaces the saved notes.
  • A saved keyboard shortcut with an impossible key is dropped when settings load, so registering it can't cause a crash.

Contributors

  • @matthrz asked to search iCloud Drive (#59).
